introduction: Don't know when is the best time to travel to Cancun? It's always important to be clear about the weather before planning your trip to the Riviera Maya. Thanks to its tropical climate, Cancun is a year-round destination, and there are seasons that are more favorable than others to enjoy its incredible beaches. You won't want rain to ruin your vacation! However, it all depends on what you're looking for.
In this post we tell you month by month what is the best time to travel to Cancun so you know what to expect at each time of year.

data.title: Where is Puerto Juarez located?
introductionParagraphs: Puerto Juarez is a town located in the municipality of Benito Juarez, in the state of Quintana Roo, Mexico. It is situated north of downtown Cancun, along the Caribbean Sea coast. It is known for being an important seaport for ferry departures to Isla Mujeres.

And if you are wondering, what is the distance between Puerto Juarez and Cancun airport? The answer is: 24.4 kilometers. Additionally, the average time you will take to cover this distance via private transfer is approximately 30 minutes.

Something very interesting about all this is that Puerto Juarez is not technically considered part of Cancun. It is considered a small area near the city of Cancun. Want to know more? Well, keep reading because now we will delve into its port and maritime terminal.

mapSection.caption: Puerto Juarez Google Map: This map highlights the maritime terminal at Puerto Juarez Beach as the main point. This neighborhood is part of Cancun and extends to Costa Mujeres. Costa Mujeres is not part of Cancun; it is a small continental area of Isla Mujeres.

data.conclusionParagraph: Now that you know a little about Puerto Juarez, you must be wondering: How to get to Puerto Juarez from Cancun? How to get from Cancun airport to Puerto Juarez? And even, how to get from Playa del Carmen to Puerto Juarez? Well, we will describe all that a bit here in this section, but remember: If you want to delve deeper, we have complete and technical articles that talk about the steps you need to follow to reach the small fishing village of Puerto Juarez, Quintana Roo.

sections.title: How to get to Puerto Juarez from Cancun?
paragraphs: If you are in Cancun and wish to get to Puerto Juarez, whether to take the ferry to Isla Mujeres, visit the El Meco archaeological zone, explore the small town, or enjoy its gastronomy, get to know and cool off at its beaches, then here we will explain step by step how to do it.

As you may already know, downtown Cancun is the point where buses, colectivos, and taxis are taken to reach any other part of Cancun or even outside of it. Therefore, you can imagine that to get to Puerto Juarez, you first need to be in downtown Cancun.

So, how can I get to downtown Cancun? It is usually not very complicated to get to downtown Cancun, almost all public transport bus routes arrive here, however, downtown Cancun is a bit broad in context, so how to get to Puerto Juarez from downtown Cancun?

image.alt: How to get to Puerto Juarez from Cancun

paragraphs: The 'crucero' (crossing) is part of downtown Cancun and can be found between José López Portillo Avenue and Tulum Avenue. At this intersection, you can take one of the buses or colectivos that go through Puerto Juarez and, in some cases, Costa Mujeres and part of Playa Mujeres.

It is worth mentioning that this is not the only alternative. From downtown Cancun, you can take a taxi to Puerto Juarez, but this can cost from 200 MXN to 300 MXN, which in USD is approximately 10 to 15 USD.

It should be noted that, being part of Cancun, it is much easier to find frequent transportation to Puerto Juarez, and again we repeat: Downtown Cancun is broad, and the place you are looking for to board transportation to any part of Puerto Juarez is at the crucero.

sections.title: How to get to Puerto Juarez from the Cancun Hotel Zone?

paragraphs.text: From the Hotel Zone, you can also get to any part of Puerto Juarez, but it is necessary to understand that to do so, you have to make a combination of 2 or 3 public transportation services.
Why public transportation? Because the taxi services you can hire in the Hotel Zone can charge up to 800 MXN or more to take you to Puerto Juarez, and we don’t want that, right?

Our first bus will be taken outside our hotel. Normally, outside any of the hotels in the Hotel Zone, we will find 'bus stops,' and if we are not very patient, we will take any bus that goes to downtown Cancun.
Normally there are buses that can take you directly to the crucero, but if you are not patient, you can take any other bus.
So, from downtown, you can take another bus to the crucero and from there, take transportation to Puerto Juarez. As simple and easy as that.

data.title: Puerto Juarez to Isla Mujeres
descriptionParagraphs: The maritime terminal of Puerto Juarez is the main connection point for maritime transportation to and from Isla Mujeres. Now that we have explored the various ways to get to this place, you must surely be wondering about the distance and cost of the ferry, right? Well, we will answer those questions now!

What is the price of the ferry from Puerto Juarez to Isla Mujeres? The cost of the ferry from Puerto Juarez to Isla Mujeres is 270 Mexican pesos (14.25 USD) per trip for adults and 200 Mexican pesos (10.25 USD) for children. For a round trip, the price is 540 Mexican pesos (28.50 USD) for adults and 400 Mexican pesos (20.50 USD) for children.

What is the distance from Puerto Juarez to Isla Mujeres? The distance from the Puerto Juarez maritime terminal to Isla Mujeres is 13.9 km, and the average trip duration by ferry is 25 minutes or less. This will depend on the weather conditions at the time of your trip.

It is important to mention that these prices are for the general public. There are special rates that are usually cheaper for state residents, senior citizens, and slightly higher prices if you opt for VIP overseas maritime transfer services.

recommendations.text: Before planning your trip to Acapulco, it is important to consider some factors to ensure your experience is unforgettable. Therefore, we share some key recommendations that will help you enjoy your trip to the fullest.

The climate in Acapulco is tropical with two main seasons: the dry season (November to April) and the rainy season (May to October). During the dry season, temperatures range between 24°C and 30°C, while in the rainy season they can reach up to 33°C with high humidity.
We recommend bringing light and comfortable clothing, such as t-shirts, shorts, and swimsuits, as well as sunscreen, a hat or cap, and sunglasses to protect yourself from the intense sun.
During the rainy season, bring a small umbrella or raincoat and quick-drying footwear, as the rains are usually brief but intense.
It is important to stay hydrated at all times, especially if you plan outdoor activities like hiking or visits to archaeological sites.
The hurricane season extends from early June to late November. However, the sea temperature is higher between September and October, which also means a greater risk of hurricanes during that period.

During these months, we recommend paying more attention to local weather reports. Additionally, some important recommendations include having a supply of water, food, and an evacuation plan in case it becomes necessary.

seasons.seasonTitle: 1. Traveling to Cancun in the Dry Season (November to April)
seasonIntroductionParagraphs: If you are one of those who seek to enjoy a warm and dry climate, from November to April is the best time to travel to Cancun.

Especially January: it is the month we most recommend for visiting this beautiful destination. The temperature you will find ranges between 24 and 30ºC, making this the best time to travel to Cancun and enjoy its beaches. Additionally, during these months it is less likely to rain, making it the ideal time to practice water sports like diving, snorkeling, or kayaking. And since you will be outdoors, we should tell you that another advantage of this season is that with less humidity, there are also fewer mosquitoes that might bother you. As for the number of tourists, this period is considered high season in Cancun. Therefore, it is important to consider your budget for accommodation, flights, and other activities, as they can be more expensive. However, if you plan your trip in advance, you will find interesting offers and enjoy an unforgettable experience.

descriptionParagraphs: If you are looking for a pleasant climate with fewer tourists, November can be one of the best times to travel to Cancun. During this season, you will find an average temperature of around 27°C. Along with this, you will enjoy cool nights that will invite you to stroll along the beach or savor a dinner outdoors. Additionally, the sea water remains warm, similar to the ambient temperature, making it perfect for swimming, diving, or practicing water sports.

As for the number of tourists, it is lower than during high season, so you can visit tourist attractions without large crowds. You will also be able to enjoy the beaches without much hustle and bustle and attend some of the major concerts scheduled in the city. Another main attraction of this month is the Day of the Dead, celebrated on November 1 and 2. During this beautiful tribute to the deceased, you will find impressive decorations, ceremonies, and a spectacular parade that we are sure you will want to witness. Regarding budget, you will find offers on hotels and flights, making November a very appealing time to visit Cancun.

In December, the days in Cancun are shorter, but the temperature remains around 28°C during the day and 20°C at night. However, this is a quite expensive month to travel to Cancun due to the Christmas holidays. Many North Americans and Europeans travel to Cancun to spend Christmas and New Year on the beach. This causes prices to rise significantly! So, this month marks the beginning of tourist arrivals, which can already be considered high season.

The warm climate and sea temperature are ideal for enjoying the nightlife in the Cancun Hotel Zone. During your visit, we recommend joining the Sunset Boat Parade, where you can admire illuminated boats on Laguna Nichupté, perfect for sharing with family and friends.

For us, January is the best month to travel to Cancun! There’s nothing better than starting the year in one of Mexico’s most surprising destinations. In January, the temperature varies between 19°C and 28°C, which is perfect for enjoying the beach without being overwhelmed by the heat. Additionally, there are fewer tourists than in the more crowded winter months, meaning prices are lower and places are not as full.

The climate during this season is irresistible; you can enjoy warm, dry, and sunny weather. While it is possible to experience occasional rains, since the hurricane season has ended, it is safer to travel to Cancun. It’s also a great opportunity to take excursions to the many Mayan ruins in Tulum. Regarding budget, in January you can find attractive offers on flights and accommodation. So, if you’re looking to save some euros on your vacation, this is the perfect month. Undoubtedly, the best time to travel to Cancun.

February is another dry and sunny month to visit Cancun, with warm and pleasant temperatures for enjoying the sun and beach, ranging from 26°C during the day to 20°C at night. Rain is scarce, and humidity is low, making the weather conditions excellent for outdoor activities like diving, snorkeling, or simply relaxing on the beach.

Another advantage of this month is that the conditions are among the best for a day of tourism. So don’t forget to pack your most comfortable shoes to visit the Chichén Itzá archaeological complex, probably Mexico’s most important attraction. However, February is still considered a high season month, though with relatively fewer tourists than January. This is mainly due to the carnival held in the city. During the event, you will find a variety of sweets, lively dances, costumes, and incredibly decorated floats.

If you hate rain, March is one of the best months to travel to Cancun. Rain is almost nonexistent! Plus, if you also love going out to party, March is probably the best time to visit Cancun. Especially because many U.S. students head to this beach to enjoy their spring break. This month you will find an average temperature of 29°C and a somewhat more humid climate.

However, this atmosphere might not be what you’re looking for, and you might prefer to venture into the Mexican jungle in search of the tallest pyramids. You can also participate in the Cancun Half Marathon, an annual event held on March 5 for International Women’s Day. Overall, this season is more expensive than usual due to the number of tourists entering this destination.

April is the driest month of the year in Cancun. It barely rains three days in the whole month! Plus, the rainy season is just around the corner, and many take advantage to enjoy the beach before the rains arrive. So this month is also quite popular, with a large number of tourists in the area. However, there are several events and festivities to celebrate the founding of Cancun, making it an exciting time to visit the city.

If you enjoy music festivals, you can take advantage of your stay to attend the Paradise Blue Festival, a three-day electronic music event that attracts music fans from around the world. Additionally, you can participate in the Cancun Music Week, celebrated over five days. But if you’re traveling with family, you should also note that April 30 celebrates Children’s Day, offering discounts on activities. Alongside this, the average temperature in April is 30°C, making it another good option to enjoy the sea and sun.

seasons.seasonTitle: 2. Traveling to Cancun in the Rainy Season (May to October)
seasonIntroductionParagraphs: Traveling to Cancun during the rainy season can be a different experience. This period spans from May to October and can be a good opportunity to enjoy water sports. The temperature remains warm, with a climate that can range from 23°C to 33°C. Additionally, prices are usually lower than during high season, which will be an advantage for travelers looking to save some money.

However, it is important to mention that the weather is the factor you should pay the most attention to, as in certain months, the rains can be quite intense. There is also a higher risk of hurricanes during this season. But don’t worry, as resorts and local authorities are usually prepared for them.

descriptionParagraphs: May marks the beginning of the rainy season in Cancun, meaning there are more chances of isolated storms. However, the sea temperature remains warm, averaging 28°C, making it a good time to enjoy the beach. Additionally, this month is considered low season, resulting in cheaper prices for accommodation and other activities for those looking to save.

If you are a nature lover, this month will delight you! As the flora and fauna are in full bloom. Interestingly, the sea turtle nesting season in Cancun is a natural process that occurs every year from May to September. It’s a very beautiful moment! Moreover, the average ambient temperature is 28 to 30°C during the day and 24 to 26°C at night. So, if you think about spending less and are prepared for the possibility of occasional rains, May can be a good time to travel to Cancun.

In Cancun, the hurricane season begins in June, so you should pay attention to local weather recommendations. However, this should not stop you from visiting this beautiful destination. The average air temperature remains between 25°C to 32°C, while the sea temperature is approximately 28°C. Plus, since the rains have not yet peaked, you will have many opportunities to enjoy the beach and water activities.

Regarding budget, you will find good prices before the high season arrives. However, note that June is a popular month for graduation trips, meaning there may be more young tourists in the Hotel Zone. But if you prefer going out to sea over staying at the hotel, you will love diving. June is one of the best months for it. The water temperature is warmer, and there are many options to explore the coral reefs and marine life in the area.

July is one of the hottest months in Cancun, with an average temperature of 28°C. Although it is also one of the wettest months, with an average of 130mm of rain, which can cause some storms. Moreover, this is a month full of events and festivities, such as the Caribbean Festival, which offers a variety of cultural and musical activities that we are sure you will enjoy.

We must also remind you that this is a high season month in Cancun, so prices may be higher. But if you don’t mind spending a bit more, you can observe small sea turtle hatchlings and more marine life in the region.

August is the warmest month to travel to Cancun, with temperatures that can reach 33°C. Additionally, this is one of the most popular months for tourists, as many countries have summer vacations. This, in turn, causes prices to be higher than usual.

Regarding the weather, you can expect some rainy days due to the hurricane season, but most will be sunny and hot. Make sure to bring light clothing, sunscreen, and try to visit the beaches early in the morning or at sunset to avoid the midday sun. Personally, we would try to avoid traveling to Cancun in August due to the high prices and rains.

September is the peak of the hurricane season. Therefore, you won’t find crowds of tourists, but you will find lower prices on accommodation and activities. Additionally, September is the rainiest month in Cancun, so there may be some interruptions in outdoor activities. During this month, you will experience temperatures up to 32°C and extreme humidity.

However, if you wish to visit Cancun in September, you can also attend the festivities for Mexico’s Independence Day. Here you will be dazzled by the dance, music, and incredible fireworks. Despite the important events, we believe it is not the best time to travel to Cancun.

Due to Halloween, traveling to Cancun in October is an excellent option for those seeking to have fun at the city’s hotels, bars, and nightclubs. This month, the temperature is slightly less warm, but there can still be rains. However, the days are mostly sunny, and the water temperature remains pleasant for swimming and water sports.

Regarding budget, you will find attractive offers on hotels and tourist activities. Plus, you will discover fewer tourists on the beaches, meaning you will enjoy a more relaxing experience. If you are passionate about music or fishing, try attending the Island Time Music Festival, which over four days organizes musical performances and fishing competitions on the beautiful Isla Mujeres.

data.sectionTitle: 5. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS ABOUT THE BEST TIME TO TRAVEL TO CANCUN
data.introduction: Below, as a summary of the article, we will answer some questions about the best time to travel to Cancun.

faqList.question: Ultimately, what is the best month to travel to Cancun?
faqList.answer: January is the best month to travel to Cancun. However, it’s better to wait until the first week passes and prices drop, as they tend to remain high after the Christmas, New Year, and Epiphany festivities. During the last three weeks of January, there are not as many crowds as in March and April, and it’s not as hot. Our favorite month to travel to Cancun!

faqList.question: When is the high season in Cancun?
faqList.answer: The high season in Cancun runs from December to April, with the busiest months being January, February, and March. During this period, prices are higher, but the weather is drier and sunnier.

faqList.question: When is the hurricane season in Cancun?
faqList.answer: The hurricane season in Cancun runs from June to November, with September and October being the months of highest risk. However, direct hurricanes are rare, and the tourist infrastructure is prepared for these situations.

faqList.question: What is the cheapest season to travel to Cancun?
faqList.answer: The cheapest season to travel to Cancun is from May to October (rainy season), especially September when there are fewer tourists. However, you must consider the risk of rain and hurricanes.

faqList.question: What clothes to bring to Cancun according to the time of year?
faqList.answer: In the dry season (November-April): light cotton clothing, sunscreen, sunglasses, and a light jacket for the nights. In the rainy season (May-October): light clothing, a raincoat, umbrella, and quick-drying footwear.

data.sectionTitle: 6. CONCLUSION: THE BEST TIME TO TRAVEL TO CANCUN
conclusionParagraphs: After analyzing the weather conditions, prices, and activities available in Cancun month by month, we can conclude that the best time to travel to this paradise destination largely depends on your personal preferences and budget.

If you seek perfect weather with little chance of rain and don’t mind paying higher prices, the dry season (November to April) is ideal for you. January stands out as our favorite month for offering the perfect balance between good weather, reasonable prices after the Christmas holidays, and fewer crowds than in March.

On the other hand, if you are a traveler on a limited budget and don’t mind occasional rains, the wet season (May to October) will allow you to enjoy Cancun at more accessible prices. May and October are excellent options within this season.

Remember that Cancun is a beautiful destination all year round. The key is to plan your trip according to your priorities: Do you prefer perfect weather or low prices? Do you like tranquility or don’t mind crowds? Whatever your choice, Cancun will welcome you with its white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and the warmth of its people.
data.finalCallToAction: Now that you know the best time to travel to Cancun according to your needs, it’s time to start planning your adventure in the Mexican Caribbean!
